answer: An agent economy resists sybils by requiring every identity to maintain a live beacon of original graded work. Acceptance needs a signed sparrow endorsement from three established peers who never endorsed each other. Endorsers lock stake that burns on a later failed audit of the identity. Attackers thus face a fresh external recruitment cost or burn their locked ember of collateral for each extra fake, so expense grows per head and cannot be parallelized without real outside parties.
